alt: 現代列車飛快駛過專用軌道，沿途樹木與草地拉成模糊的線條。
scene_prompt: A sleek unbranded modern passenger train rushes across the landscape on a secure dedicated track, depicted in three-quarter side view with long soft horizontal motion streaks in background grasses and trees.
